column3: Settled in the pack early - began to make progress into contention 2f out - pushed to the front approaching the final furlong - pulled clear late to score
Settled off the pace early - pushed along and made progress over a furlong out then angled left for room and stayed on inside the final furlong - runner-up beaten a length
Pulled hard at the back - moved up travelling strongly 2f out and pushed to challenge over 1f out - stuck on into 3rd but had no more to offer late
Held up in touch with back markers - urged into effort over 2f out and kept responding inside final furlong - finished fourth without quickening
Settled close to the pace early - moved to the front after 4f then pushed along and overtaken with a furlong left - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish fifth
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left but couldn't find extra - dropped away inside the closing furlong
Settled in the pack - driven with over 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 7th
Held up towards back of field - unable to get involved with leading group - finished well held in 8th
Held up eagerly early - travelled close to pace and pushed along to challenge over 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish 9th
Held up early with plenty of enthusiasm at rear - roused approaching final furlong - swift progress through the pack close home - stayed on to hit the front near the line and score
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and made ground over a furlong out - responded well inside final furlong - never quite able to reach the winner - grabbed second right on the line
Handy early - hit front a furlong out - overtaken approaching final furlong - stayed on well to grab third near line

Settled towards the back of the field - roused approaching 2f out - advanced to challenge the front rank over 1f out - hit the front momentarily inside the final furlong - pegged back and dropped away late to finish 4th
Held a forward position - pressed for effort with a furlong left - stayed on at one gait to the line - finished 5th beaten 3 lengths
Held a forward position early - pushed along with under a furlong left and responded briefly - then lost ground close home to finish sixth
Held up towards the back from the off - made no impression - finished well held in 7th
Held in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left but failed to close - dropped away inside final furlong
Went straight to front - lost the advantage and pressed for effort inside final furlong - faded quickly to finish 9th
Settled at rear early - progress under pressure to hit the front inside final furlong - stayed on to win
Pulled hard at the back of the pack - strong progress between rivals inside the final furlong - just failed to peg back the winner
Settled in the pack - pushed along a furlong out - found extra ground inside the last - grabbed third late
Held up in the pack - urged into contention over a furlong out - challenged the pace-setter approaching the final furlong - faded inside the last 110yds to miss third late
Handy early - pressed for effort inside final furlong - couldn't quicken and finished 5th
Set the tempo in front - pressed for effort with 2f to run and lost the advantage inside the final furlong - kept going at an unchanged gait to finish sixth beaten 4.5 lengths
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with a furlong left - kept on at one gait to the line - finished 7th
Settled just behind the leader - pushed along inside the final furlong - dropped away in the closing stages - eventually beaten well into 8th
Handy in behind the front group early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 9th
Settled mid-pack - pushed along with a furlong left - closed strongly to reach the front-runner inside the final furlong - edged ahead close home to score by a whisker
Sat close to pace early - roused along with over 2f left - closed on the pacesetter inside the final furlong - stayed on to go down by a whisker in 2nd
Set the pace early - pushed along a furlong out and held on well under pressure - weakened in the final strides to be caught - finished third
Settled in the pack - nudged along and found a gap inside the final furlong - ran on but unable to get to the front group to finish 4th
Went straight to front - dropped to back of field - pushed along and made progress a furlong out - stayed on to finish fifth beaten just over a length
Handy spot behind front group - pressed for effort with a furlong left - held on at one gait through to the line - finished sixth beaten 1¾ lengths
Settled at the back from the off - never able to make an impact - finished 7th
Raced with enthusiasm early - sat close to the front - pushed along over a furlong out - lost momentum inside the last to finish eighth
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with over 2f left - lost touch inside the final furlong to finish 9th
Held up in the pack - driven with over 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along to hit the front approaching final furlong - stayed on well under hand riding to the line - won comfortably
Settled in the pack - pushed along a furlong out and found extra close home - narrowly outpaced by the winner throughout

Settled towards the back of the pack - urged forward with over two furlongs remaining - responded and stayed on - found room to advance inside the final furlong - grabbed third late but had nothing more to give

Held up towards the back of the pack early - pushed to go on with over 2f left - driven into contention with a furlong to run - stayed on briefly before fading inside the last 110 yards - edged out of third late to finish fourth
Settled in the pack - pushed to reach the front with a furlong left - quickly found no more - stayed on steadily to the line for 5th
Settled at the back - moved left for room and made progress inside final furlong - pushed along but weakened close home to finish sixth
Held up in the pack - driven with over 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong
Held up handy in the early stages - pushed along over a furlong out - lost ground close home to finish eighth
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and lost the advantage inside the last two furlongs - dropped away close home to finish ninth
Handy in the early running - pushed along over 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish tenth

Settled just behind the pace early - fighting for its head under restraint - improved into second spot 2f out - asked for effort with a furlong left - hit the front early in the last furlong - challenged inside final 110 yards but stayed on strongly to win

Settled just off the pace early - fighting for control - slipped to the back 3f out - angled left and asked for effort 2f out - found extra ground on the outside - closed to be second and chased winner inside final furlong - stayed on well to be beaten just a short head
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort in third with 2f left - urged into fourth 1f out but couldn't close - reclaimed third inside the final furlong and stayed on steadily

Settled just off the pace early - fourth two out - into third but boxed in a furlong out - darted left for room and was hampered - unable to regain momentum before the line - finished fourth beaten 3½ lengths
Set the pace early - driven approaching final two furlongs before losing top spot early in the last - dropped away in the closing stages to finish fifth
Sat close to pace early fighting for control - 4th and driven 2f out - soon lost momentum finishing 6th beaten 14 lengths
Settled just behind pace - 3rd at halfway - pushed along and made ground on the inner approaching 2f out - hit the front over a furlong out and stayed on strongly to the line
Settled midfield early - driven into contention 2f out to lead the runner-up spot - stayed on at one gait through the closing stages for second
Held up towards the back - pushed along and made progress out wide approaching 2f out - up to 6th with a furlong left before finishing well to take 3rd inside the final 150 yards
Handy in behind early - 4th at halfway - hampered approaching 2f out then eased right and dropped to 7th with a furlong left - finished off strongly to close late
Sat close to the pace - 5th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out and up to 4th with a furlong left - unable to close final stages
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along with no headway approaching 2f out and 10th passing the furlong marker - finished off the effort steadily to the line

Went straight to front early - lost command approaching 3f and settled second by the midway point - pushed along and drifted off a straight line inside final 2f - third with no real threat a furlong out and held to finish well beaten
Settled around midfield - asked for effort inside final two furlongs - couldn't land a blow and stayed on at one gear through closing stages - finished eighth beaten 9½ lengths
Settled in the pack - driven and unable to make headway 2f out - faded through the final furlong to finish 9th
Up with the pace early - hit front after 3f - pressed for effort with 2f remaining and quickly overtaken - unable to find more inside final furlong - finished well held in 10th
Held up at the back throughout - driven with two furlongs left but made no headway - couldn't quicken after that and finished well held
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with two furlongs left but failed to close - held no more late and finished well beaten
Held up at the back - made no headway into the race - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished well beaten in 13th
Held up at the back - lost touch and offered nothing - beaten well before the final furlong - finished last of the field well beaten
Held up towards the back - nudged for effort with the finish approaching but dropped away - found nothing more and allowed to finish in own time - well held in 15th
Urged forward from the back early - still towards the tail through halfway - driven but flattened out from 2f out and allowed to coast home last
Handy in the pack - moved through to command 3f out - pushed along inside final two furlongs - stayed on strongly to the line
Went straight to the front - lost the advantage but stayed close over 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out - finished strongly to claim second by three-quarters of a length
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - responded and stayed on - strong finish to snatch third
Settled in the pack - roused along with 2f left - moved up to challenge close home - faded inside final 100yds finishing 4th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - stayed on gamely inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Settled towards back early - pushed along and made progress from 2f out - moved right and stayed on inside final furlong - weakened near line to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - pushed along approaching final 2f and edged past tiring runners over 1f out - couldn't quicken again late
Settled towards the back of the field - pushed along with 3f left - eased through some faded runners into the closing stages to finish 8th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 9th
Settled handy in the early stages - pushed up to challenge in front approaching 2f out - lost momentum inside the final furlong and faded to finish tenth
Settled towards the back of the pack early - offered little in the closing stages - well held in 11th
Settled towards the back of the pack from the off - never troubled the front end - beaten a long way home in 12th
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped away over 2f out - well held at the finish
Settled towards the back of the pack from the off - stayed there for the whole trip - well held at the finish
Handy in the pack early - roused into contention 2f out - hit front inside final furlong and edged clear near line - stayed on strongly to score
Settled in the main pack - progress from 2f out - held up for a gap over 1f out then angled left to grab second inside the final 110yds - not able to match the winner's tempo at the end
Held up handy in second early - driven approaching 2f out and edged right inside final furlong - lost place close home - finished third beaten 3 lengths
Settled in second early - hit the front over 3f out - pressed for effort a furlong out then drifted right and lost the advantage - lost ground close home to finish fourth
Settled towards the back of the pack - shifted wide to improve position 2f out - lost momentum inside final furlong - dropped away late to finish fifth
Settled off the pace towards the back - pushed along to close on the inside from 2f out - faded in the closing stages to finish 6th
Settled towards the back - nudged into contention on the outside 3f out - lost ground from the final furlong and a half then dropped away close home
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort 2f out - lost touch and dropped away late
Handy early - urged on 4f out - dropped away rapidly 3f out - well beaten from 2f out to finish ninth
Went straight to front and dictated a modest gallop - driven up when overtaken 3f out - soon lost touch with rivals - dropped away rapidly inside final furlong to finish tenth

Settled just behind the front group while fighting for a stronger grip - fourth at the halfway point - nudged into third approaching 2f out - driven into second with a furlong left - hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score

Handy just behind the front pair early - third at halfway - urged into second two out - dropped to third a furlong out - rallied into second inside final 110 yards but couldn't reel in winner - stuck on for second
Settled just behind leaders - asked for effort 2f out but made no headway - one-paced through final furlong - finished third
Sluggish start - settled towards back - urged into contest 2f out - lacked fluency inside final furlong making no headway - stayed on same gear to finish fourth
Settled towards the back - fighting for a stronger position early - urged forward with 2f left - into fourth a furlong out but unable to find more and finished 5th
Set the pace early - driven approaching final furlong and drifted left before being overtaken - faded in the closing stages to finish sixth
Settled just behind the pace - asked for effort over 2f out but made no headway - unable to find more inside the last and beaten into 7th
Sat close behind pace early - pushed along in third with 2f left - dropped away quickly - finished eighth
Settled at the back early - travelled keenly without threatening leaders - urged into effort with 2f left - lost ground late to finish 9th
Held up at the back throughout - no impact on proceedings - pushed along and drifted wide over 2f out then dropped away
Held up towards back of the pack - began to make progress 3f out - urged into 4th spot 2f out - hit front 1f out drifting left approaching the line - kept responding to the whip to prevail

Settled just behind the pacesetter early - fighting for a strong grip - urged forward with 2f left - edged off straight approaching the final furlong - finished full of running to place second by a short margin
Went straight to front - asked for effort 3f out then challenged hard and slipped to third with a furlong left - held on at unchanged tempo to finish third
Sat close to the front pack - pushed along into 5th with 2f left - up to 4th approaching the final furlong and finished 4th
Held up towards the back - improved into contention 3f out and pushed along into 5th - unable to find more in the closing stages
Sat close to the front pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left and slipped to 6th approaching the final furlong - unable to close the gap late
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 3f left but unable to close - stayed on same speed to finish 7th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along 3f out - unable to close the gap - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f remaining - unable to close - eventually finished ninth
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort 2f out - unable to close - finished well beaten in 10th
Sat close to the front pack early - pushed along 3f out - dropped away thereafter - finished well beaten in 11th
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with three furlongs left - dropped away steadily to finish 12th
Held up in rear throughout - no impression made - well held at finish
Settled in the pack early - urged forward to move up inside on the rail approaching 2f out then hit the front with a furlong left - stayed on strongly to the line for victory
Sat just off the pace - 5th at halfway - boxed in inside final 2f and shifted left approaching the furlong pole - 4th with 150 yards left before finishing strongly to grab second

Encouraged early in the pack - up with front group and 4th at halfway - driven to move up and get on terms with 1 1/2f left - 2nd approaching the furlong pole but couldn't find more late on to finish 3rd
Driven early towards the back - improved into contention entering the straight and up to 3rd inside the final furlong - held to finish 4th
Sat close to pace early - 3rd at halfway - pushed along and shared front spot approaching 2f out - dropped to 4th with a furlong left then found nothing more late
Held up at back - urged forward to make late progress from 2f out and 8th out wide inside final two furlongs - stayed on same effort to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - urged into effort in the straight - 10th and asked for more with a furlong left - stayed on at one speed to finish 7th
Sat handy in behind early - 6th at halfway - pushed along with 2f left but unable to close - held on late for 8th
Went straight to front - held a healthy advantage at the midpoint before being caught 1 1/2f out - dropped away quickly and had nothing left to give in the closing stages
Held a midfield position - pushed along inside final 2f but couldn't quicken - stayed on same pace to the line - finished 10th
Held up towards the back of the pack - asked for effort inside final 2f but made no headway - finished well held in 11th
Under early urging just behind front-runner - disputed second at halfway - dropped away soon after turning in and faded to finish 12th
Held up towards back - lost touch soon after - unable to find more entering straight - well held in 13th
Settled midpack early - driven and dropped towards the back turning for home - unable to find more inside final 2f - well held at the finish
Shared front spot early - locked in close battle inside final two furlongs - edged clear approaching final furlong - kept going strongly to score

Took a strong hold sharing front spot - pushed along 2f out battling for the advantage - edged one furlong out but rallied under pressure - stayed on to finish just behind at the line - beaten 2 lengths in second
Held up mid-pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on inside final furlong to finish third
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f remaining - kept going at one speed inside the closing furlong - finished 4th
Held up towards the back - pushed along 3f out but unable to close - dropped away final furlong
Held up towards back showing early enthusiasm - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to find more thereafter - finished sixth
Sat fourth early - pushed along approaching final 2f - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 7th
Held up eagerly in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - well held at the finish
Sat handy in third early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away over 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up at rear - pushed along with 4f left - dropped away and well beaten from 3f out - finished last
Settled mid-pack early - stayed close to the front group - moved right approaching the final furlong - finished strongly to hit the front inside the last 110 yards - kept finding more to win
Settled towards the back early - stuck for room approaching final furlong - angled clear inside final 110yds - flew home late to snatch second close home
Sat close to pace early - hit front a furlong out - pushed along in final furlong before overtaken close home - just edged out of second on the line
Held up towards the back - progress made a furlong out then boxed in with a hundred yards left - finished well once in space to finish 4th beaten a length
Settled handy in the pack - pressed the pace with a furlong to run - pushed along inside the last - lost momentum close home to finish fifth beaten 2¼ lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along to close ground from the furlong marker - unable to quicken again late - came home sixth beaten two and a half lengths
Set the pace early - driven and lost front spot inside final furlong - fading and squeezed for space close home to finish 7th
Settled midpack in the early stages - driven to keep up approaching the final furlong - dropped away soon after - trailed the field over the closing 110 yards
Settled handy on the rail early - hit the front two furlongs out and edged away approaching the final furlong - kept on unchallenged to win easily
Settled towards the back early - made ground into contention two out - moved into second inside the final furlong but couldn't threaten the leader - stayed on to finish second beaten 3.5 lengths
Settled midfield - stepped up effort inside final two furlongs and stayed on well - unable to reel in leader late but held third
Disputed the pace - driven 3f out - faded inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Sluggish start - settled at the back - closed a little inside final furlong but held throughout - finished 5th
Settled towards the back - squeezed for space with a couple of furlongs left - pushed along inside the final furlong but no impression made
Settled in the pack - dropped away on the outside from beyond 2f out - out of contention from over 1f out
Went straight to front - lost command 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished eighth
Settled with the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Sat handy early on a firm grip - fourth at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left - moved into second soon after - hit the front a furlong out and challenged again - stayed on strongly to prevail
Settled just off the pace early - urged forward and made ground 2f out - into third with a furlong left - moved up to challenge for the lead - stayed on but couldn't reel in winner
Held a midfield position early - urged forward approaching 3f out - driven but unable to gain ground inside the final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish third

Slow into stride - settled towards the back and travelling comfortably in midfield - moved left approaching 2f out and pushed along - made progress to be third inside the final furlong - unable to find more in the closing stages
Sat close up early - driven into contention 3f out but unable to land a blow 2f out - dropped away final furlong to finish fifth
Sent clear early on own line in the straight - urged into effort over 2f out then driven approaching final furlong - overtaken with a furlong left - quickly lost ground after finishing sixth
Sat close to the front pair - fighting for control early - third at halfway - driven from 2f out with no gain on the front - lost touch inside the final furlong to finish seventh
Slow to start - settled in the pack - squeezed for room and driven approaching 2f out then asked for effort inside final furlong - held no more in reserve at the finish
Held up near back - driven for effort with 3f left - unable to close from 2f out - finished well held in 9th
Held up at the back throughout - urged into effort with 2f left - lost ground final furlong to finish tenth
Settled just off the pace early - asked for effort with three furlongs left but made no headway - dropped away soon after finishing well beaten in 11th
Settled midfield early - improved into third approaching two out then pushed clear before the last - powered away up the run-in to score
Held up towards back on wide side - improved into 5th before 2 out then edged into runner-up spot at the last - stayed on at one effort to finish second

Settled around midfield - improved into 6th approaching final two furlongs and pressed for effort - moved up to 3rd at the last - stayed on strongly to the line but unable to get to the front two - finished third
Shared front spot early - lost command at the 5th - pressed for effort in second two out - slipped to fourth after a small stumble at the last and held on for no more
Shared front spot early - went clear from 5th - pressed for effort 2 out - lost command before last - held 5th spot at the finish with nothing more to give
Held up towards the back - made progress into 9th and pushed along 2 out - stayed on same speed to finish 6th
Held up towards the back - pushed along and made up ground into 8th two out - unable to threaten leading pair - finished 7th
Held up towards the back - pushed along in 11th 2 out - stayed on same gear to finish - eighth
Sat close to the front pack early - pushed along in 4th two out - dropped away late to finish 9th
Up with the front group - serious blunder at the 8th - faded in the straight and came home 10th
Sat close to the front pack early - pressed for effort in 7th two out - dropped away late finishing 11th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along after 7th - dropped away late - eventually finished 12th
Sat close to the front pack early - pressed for effort and slipped back to 10th two out - lost touch late finishing 13th
Held up at rear from the off - lost touch through the contest - finished well beaten in 14th
Settled around midfield - lost touch three out and dropped away - pulled up before the final fence
Raced eagerly early - set the pace throughout - pressed for effort 2f out and drifted right approaching final furlong - stayed on to win
Raced with plenty of eagerness early - tracked the leader throughout - pressed for effort 2f out - drifted right approaching final furlong - stayed on at one level to finish second
Drifted left at the break - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left and stayed on at one gear to finish third beaten 3 lengths

Sat behind front group early - into 4th and making progress before halfway - kicked on into the lead with a furlong and a half left - drifted left under pressure inside the final furlong but stayed on top
Sat behind the pace - pushed along and drifted left approaching 2f out then moved into second inside the final furlong - stayed on to go down by a short margin

Sat close to the pace early - moved up to disputed second by halfway and went ahead turning in - pressed before being overtaken with a furlong and a half left then unable to close again late finishing third

Sat close to the pace early - 5th at halfway - driven on turning for home and briefly bumped inside the final two furlongs - into 4th and pressed for effort with a furlong left before finishing without response
Held up towards back early - 6th at halfway then driven up entering straight to 5th over 1f out - unable to find more inside final furlong finishing 5th
Held up towards the back - urged forward turning into the straight but made no headway - held sixth spot from the final furlong marker
Held up at the back - driven but making no headway by halfway - stayed on same speed from the final furlong without threatening
Shared front spot early then went clear after 2f - shaken up before losing command entering straight - asked for more soon after and found nothing inside final 2f - well held at finish
Shared the pace early - slipped through the pack to the back by the turn - pushed along but made no headway and faded through the closing stages
Held up at back - dropped away entering straight and soon allowed to drop out of it - well beaten at the line
Set the pace from the off - clear of the field by the 3f mark - driven on approaching 2f out - kept on well inside the final furlong - shut down late and won readily
Settled in fourth - pushed along 3f out - made progress inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to snatch second late
Sat third early - pushed along 3f out - responded briefly inside final furlong - weakened late to finish third
Settled in fifth early - pushed along with 3f remaining - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Settled just behind the pace - pressed for effort with 3f remaining - dropped away inside the final furlong
Stood up at the off - settled at the back and stayed there - well held in 6th
Held mid-pack early - angled across to find running room a furlong out and surged clear late - hit front close to the line to score
Went straight to front and dictated a fast gallop - pushed along inside final furlong - caught close home despite battling to the line
Settled close to the pace - moved into second a furlong out - pressed for effort late but slipped back to third near the line
Held handy early - shifted across to press pace with a furlong left and fully involved into the last furlong - lost momentum near the line
Held up towards the back - improved position inside final furlong - stayed on late without threatening the front group - finished fifth
Settled in the pack early - shifted wide inside final furlong - stayed on at one speed to the line - eventually 6th
Knocked and drifted left at the break - settled midpack while wide of rivals for the trip - lost momentum a furlong out - faded late to finish seventh
Held up handy in the pack - closed on the pace with a furlong left - drifted right and lost ground inside the final 110yds - finished 8th
Held up in the pack early - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 9th
Held up in the pack - unable to quicken inside final furlong - dropped away near the line - eventually came home 10th
Stumbled at the break and clipped heels before drifting right - settled at the back throughout - fell away tamely inside the final furlong to finish 11th
Handy early - hemmed in approaching final furlong before edging into second - kept responding late to get up on the line
Set the pace from the off - pushed along with 2f to run and pressed for effort inside the final furlong - just caught in the last few strides to finish second by a nose

Tracked leaders in fourth early - made ground wide two out - lost momentum approaching final furlong - drifted left to move up into third close home - stayed on for third without menacing the leading two
Settled just behind the pace early - moved into second before 2f and held that spot until inside the final furlong - lost momentum close home to finish fourth
Held up at the back - lost touch entering the final 3f - toiling with over a furlong left - trailed home in 5th

Sat just behind front group early - third at halfway - shared front spot approaching 2f out - urged forward to hit front inside final furlong - challenged strongly under pressure - found extra to prevail late

Sat behind the front group early - fourth at the midpoint - urged forward with three furlongs left - moved up but drifted left inside the final furlong - up to third with a furlong to run - second in the closing stages but unable to close further - finished second one and three-quarter lengths back

Settled just behind the pace - urged forward and made ground on the far rail two out - into second and asked for effort a furlong out - drifted left when unable to find more - stayed third but faded late
Settled midfield - driven approaching final 3f with little response 2f out - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Held up towards back - urged into midfield contention 2f out - unable to find more late on
Went straight to front then shifted to rail early on - driven approaching 3f out and lost command over 2f out - urged again but faded inside final furlong
Sat close to pace early - shared front spot under pressure approaching 2f out then gave way 1f out - faded through final furlong to finish seventh
Held up at the back - niggled at from 3f out - found little under pressure and faded to finish 8th
Sluggish getaway - held up at the back throughout with no impact - pressed for effort 2f out - dropped away late
Settled towards the back early - fighting for control under restraint - pushed along with 2f to run - faded to finish tenth
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with three furlongs left - lost touch under pressure inside the last two - eventually well held in 11th

Sat handy behind front pack - moved through to challenge approaching final fence - driven hard and matched stride for stride at the last - edged behind by a fraction inside the closing furlong then rallied to get up right on the line

Handy in front rank - hit front two out then pushed along - lost place to third before final fence - back on terms approaching last - edged in front briefly inside closing furlong - overtaken and couldn't find more late to finish second by a neck

Settled in the pack early - improved into 5th approaching final two furlongs - pushed along to reach the front before the last - overtaken and slipped to 3rd there - held that spot to the line without further response
Up with the front group - left at the 7th - pushed along in 6th approaching 2 out - moved to 5th at the last and plugged on at one speed into 4th
Settled in a forward spot early - error at the 6th - pushed along into 2nd two out - slipped back to 4th before the last and held to the line
Went straight to front - pushed along and lost advantage 2f out - unable to respond thereafter - finished sixth beaten a distance
Held in the pack early - urged for effort two out but couldn't threaten leaders - stayed on at same rate to finish seventh
Settled at the back early fighting for control - improved to 9th two out under pressure - unable to find more late finished 8th well held
Held up in the back division - severely impeded at the 7th and dropped to 10th - pushed along approaching 2 out before finishing well held in 9th
Settled midpack early - knocked back through the group after a bump at the 7th - unable to close from 3 out and well held to the line
Held up towards back of pack - made no headway from 3 out - well held throughout - finished 11th
Held up towards rear throughout - suffered a heavy knock 7th - driven on 4 out but soon well held
Settled towards the back of the field - improved position before suffering a heavy knock and coming down at the 7th
Held up towards rear from the off - knocked off stride 7th - struggling to close 3f out - fell at the last
